summary: The merged diffs implement every acceptance criterion from V01 to V17 and V19: strict ansible-lint with the jinja fix (P1), the lint and validate stages in iac-on-push (P2), vet and unit tests before the provider publish (P3), the HelmCharts gate with its two chart fixes (P4), the media values schema (P5) and the digest-pinned warn-only trivy scan (P6). V18, proof by real builds after the push, is the test phase's work under docs/slice-testing-strategy.md §4, so no implementation phase owes it. Every close-out entry is out of scope, pre-existing, or a sub-bar gap that costs the operator one word, not a phase. S7 (upstream releases are not linted, V07) and S12 (a failure to pull the sidecar, V16) now carry notes on why they are not owed. The only residue was S2, the stale comment in the provider Jenkinsfile. It is fixed in HomelabTerraformProvider 22d6d2e and struck.
